fields.note: The league is played in phases (an Opening Round of 11 games, then Closing Round split into Top Six / Bottom Six), and the season end is the Closing Round final. Nothing is published for 2026-27: that article's infobox reads 'dates = 17 August 2026 –' and the Malta Premier League / MFA Match Centre release fixtures in matchday blocks (1-6, then 1-11, then 12-16 in November 2026), so no end day exists. Value is a proxy from the previous season (same 12-team, two-phase format).

MAL2 is the second-tier Challenge League, not the Premier League whose window it inherits in the asset. Its own 2026-27 article gives 'dates = 11 September 2026 – April 2027' (month only, so no day). Value is a proxy from the same competition's previous season, which also finished in April; the inherited 05-23 (a May Premier League default) is wrong for this league.

MAL3 is the third-tier amateur competition (Maltese National League / BOV National League 1), currently carrying the Premier League window from MT1N. Its own 2026-27 article gives an exact closing day, 11 May 2027; the prose only says 'between 18 September 2026 and May 2027', so the infobox day is taken at medium confidence.
